front.title: carbon.txt: A transparency protocol for public sustainability data

abstract.t: This document specifies the carbon.txt convention, a machine-readable format for publishing links to disclosures concerning the environmental impact of an organization's digital / ICT operations at a predictable location on the web. Carbon.txt is a TOML document that acts as an index: it declares where an origin's impact disclosures (Annual reports, Sustainability policies, Third party certifications, Quantitative measurements or estimations) may be found, and optionally lists upstream service providers whose own disclosures may be relevant to the origin's environmental impact. Carbon.txt does not carry numeric impact metrics or specific claims about impacts itself; it links to documents that do. In addition it defines a discovery mechanism by which certain origins may delegate their carbon.txt implementation to another.
